title: California Permit Delays: Meet Kevin's $2 Million Fixer
description:
Meet Kevin's California permit delays frame his tour of a roughly $2 million Ventura waterfront fixer. This recap briefly covers his Park City vendor appeal and Reinvest AI promotion before examining the property's condition, six-month remodel permit wait, and argument that difficult approvals can create investor value. Remodel permits are approved, dock permits remain pending, and plans include an ADU above the garage. Airbnb would depend on scarce permits and workable numbers, with long-term rentals another option; no final return is shown.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
